adapter_notes: Original local Cartesian metre coordinates are preserved. EPSG:32631 is only a projected-metre storage carrier, not a real site location.
The calculation target is ISO 9613-2:2024 / ISO 9613-1:1993. Published 1996 results and original intervals are independent evidence; no 2024 acceptance or conformity pass is asserted.
Pressure 101.325 kPa is an adapter assumption, absent from the case inputs. Temperature 20 C, humidity 70%, downwind propagation and C0=0 are explicit.
Pruning is disabled. Reflections are disabled for T01-T18, whose published paths are direct/top/lateral screening only; T19 uses order one and its Table 65 spectral absorption.

Ground Z and acoustic height M are separate. Terrain is retained as the Table 12 rectangular contour breaklines, with explicitly resolved object ground elevations. Ground-region polygons carry XY only and add no terrain samples.
The outside-region fallback G=0 is an adapter convention. Source-receiver and T19 reflected ground paths remain within the published ground rectangles.
Inputs are taken from the report as published. No corrections from outside this edition were adopted. Published cross-reference errors and height interpretations are recorded per case.
